limitations: Single representative run on a shared managed host; no remote synchronization or native Mac shell.
Production capture sandbox unchanged and unavailable here; library/history captures can fail closed.

Visibility probes explicitly override document.hidden/visibilityState and dispatch visibilitychange because headless Chromium cannot hide tabs natively here. They test application guards, not OS/browser hidden-tab throttling.
Browser heap is the main CDP target; process-tree RSS includes browser renderer/network/GPU descendants and can count shared pages more than once.
CPU uses sampled deltas in /proc process user/system ticks; very short child-process CPU may be missed. One-core percentage can exceed100 for multiple processes.
Completed transfer byte counts exclude unfinished SSE streams; request counts retain those connections.
Post-GC checkpoint is diagnostic only; ordinary phase heap snapshots do not force garbage collection.
